blocks.x: Today is December 10th, 2010. This is the Smithsonian/ NEA Jazz Masters Award interview with Orrin Keepnews at his house in El Cerrito, California. And it is a foggy day outside, but a lot of warmth in this house. Good afternoon Orin Keepnews.

We’re no strangers and so this is, for quite a joy, and a privilege. We’ve done several projects together, well let me just say we’ve done a few projects together, of which I’m very proud. Again, its an honor to be able to conduct this interview with you, to be able to share this time with you so that you could help the listening audience, and the historians, understand—further understand your contribution to this music since our last interview, which was in 1997. You did—you were a recipient—you are a recipient of the N.E.A. Jazz Masters Award for 2011. So, we want to make sure that the world understands what Orrin Keepnews has been doing over the last two decades.
